summary: The diff introduces a new sync engine and local tombstone/pending-change tracking, plus UI sync status indicators. However, the synchronization is not fully wired to real backend persistence for creates/updates, and backend order CRUD is not clearly complete nor admin-protected as required. Several additional non-requested UI/i18n/theme changes also appear in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Replace the simulated sync engine with real synchronization so locally created/edited/deleted orders are pushed to the Motoko backend on reconnect, and successful sync results persist in backend across refresh; failures show error state without data loss.
missing_requirements.reason: The new sync code explicitly marks create as an error due to a 'structure mismatch' and skips updates, so offline-created/edited orders will not be persisted to the backend after reconnect. This fails the core 'real sync' and persistence acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend must expose and persist the complete set of admin-authorized CRUD operations required by the Orders list + Order editor UI, and the frontend must use these APIs online while keeping local storage as source of truth offline.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend authorization checks shown use a generic '#user' permission rather than enforcing admin-only access for all order operations. Also, the frontend sync path does not implement backend create/update, and there is no clear evidence the frontend loads/merges orders from backend when online/authorized.
